about: Stretches of official trailers no Reel shows (Mohammad, 27 Nov 2026, shot rules item 1): Reels are for a general Gulf audience; a kiss is fine, anything more intimate is not (kissing in a shower or bed, partial nudity, lingerie or swimwear close-ups, suggestive dancing, strip-club scenes). Keyed by trailer; each entry lists the file names, repo copies and URLs that share its timeline (a stream copy that starts later is offset by its 'start'). blocked: [start, end, reason] in seconds of the trailer. templates/blocked.py moves any shot that overlaps one on every lane; it never refuses or holds a Reel. Title cards and logo slates found while scanning are listed too (reason 'title card'), so no shot lands on them; every trailer's last 9 s (end slate) are kept clear without a listing. 'scanned' says how the entry was made: 'by eye' from 1 fps frame sheets, or 'auto' by the first-use classifier scan.
